crossRefs.note: Entering into the tomb, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, dressed in a white robe, and they were amazed.
When he had spoken these words to me, I set my face toward the ground, and was mute.
When I saw him, I fell at his feet like a dead man. He laid his right hand on me, saying, “Don’t be afraid. I am the…

translations.web: For he didn’t know what to say, for they were very afraid.
translations.bsb: For they were all so terrified that Peter did not know what else to say.
translations.kjv: For he wist not what to say; for they were sore afraid.
translations.asv: For he knew not what to answer; for they became sore afraid.
